prompt_used: You are given an image. Write a detailed natural language prompt that could have been used to generate this image. Focus on the most salient and unique visual elements such as the subjects, their clothing, expressions, actions, background, and composition. Describe the color palette, lighting, and overall style, including any cinematic or artistic qualities like camera angle, depth of field, or motion. Make the description as accurate and faithful to the image as possible. If small details are uncertain or ambiguous, omit them and prioritize capturing the overall scene, mood, and visual impression. The final prompt should be coherent, evocative, written as if by an expert visual artist or filmmaker recreating the exact scene.
caption: A young man with tousled dark hair, dressed in a fitted white t-shirt and rolled-up gray jeans, glides smoothly on a skateboard along a sunlit city street. His posture is relaxed and slightly leaning, exuding a sense of effortless cool and freedom. The scene is set in an urban environment with classic European architecture in the background, featuring stone facades and large windows. Parked cars, including a compact white car and a sleek black sedan, line the street, adding to the metropolitan atmosphere. The lighting is warm and natural, casting soft shadows and highlighting the textures of the buildings and pavement. The camera angle is low and slightly tilted, capturing the motion and dynamism of the skateboarder while maintaining a shallow depth of field that gently blurs the background, focusing attention on the subject. The overall color palette is muted and cinematic, with earthy tones and subtle contrasts, evoking a sense of youthful adventure and urban exploration.
